about_the_game:
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/story

In the neon-drenched streets of a cyberpunk metropolis, a scientific experiment has gone awry, granting you unparalleled charisma and charm.

As you navigate the complex web of relationships and alliances in this futuristic city, you'll discover that your newfound abilities have made you a magnet for the city's most powerful and beautiful women.

Step by step as you climb the ranks of the city's hierarchy, you'll encounter a diverse array of female characters, each with their own unique personalities, motivations, and desires.

From the brilliant scientist who helped create the experiment, to the sultry nightclub owner with ties to the city's underworld, each woman will present you with new opportunities and challenges as you build a network of allies and adversaries in your quest for dominance.

Will you use your charm and wit to woo the city's most powerful women, or will you resort to more underhanded tactics to get what you want?

{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gameplay

Players can choose from four distinct classes, each with its own unique abilities and playstyles:

Pulse Vanguard: Tank/Frontline Fighter

Armored to the teeth with reinforced suits and energy shields, Pulse Vanguards are the frontline defenders against any threat. They specialize in riot control, using their shields and crowd manipulation skills to hold the line against enemy attacks.

Plasma Gunner: AOE DPS

Specialists in area control and raw firepower. Armed with unstable plasma cannons that detonate on impact, they unleash devastating overload barrages to dominate the battlefield.

Void Striker: Cybernetic Assassin

Experts in lightning-fast strikes. Wielding phase blades that tear through space-time to bypass armor, they manipulate dark energy for deadly critical hits.

Scrap Berserker: Canon Glass Bruiser

Brutal warriors crafting deadly weapons from scrap metal. Thriving in close combat chaos, they trade defense for raw destructive power. Just watch out for the tetanus!

{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/features

Explore the Neon City

Dive into a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis where every district has its own culture, dangers, and opportunities. From corporate towers to underground clubs, the city breathes with secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Date Across the Factions

Meet and romance diverse women, each tied to a different sphere of influence. Your relationships open doors to hidden stories, exclusive scenes, and unexpected allies, or enemies.

Climb Through Power Struggles

Every faction has its agenda. By navigating their rivalries, making alliances, and uncovering truths, you’ll inch closer to revealing who truly controls the city.

A Unique Visual Experience

With its blend of gritty pixel art backdrops and photo-based scenes, the game delivers a nostalgic yet striking style that sets the tone for a story of desire, betrayal, and power.

name: Cyberpunk Dominion

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5+ GHz processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Not an integrated video card; DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3+ GHz processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Not an integrated video card; DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Play as the protagonist, who following a scientific experiment, will attempt to take control of the cyberpunk metropolis in this adult-themed RPG. Bend the city's various factions to your will! Date and charm multiple female characters, as you build a network in your quest for dominance.
